_comment: Single source of truth for simple content. gen_assets.py turns this into textures, models, lang and QHContentList.java.

items.name: Cherenkov Quartz
items.lore: Glows with the blue light of particles outrunning light in a medium.

items.name: Degenerate Matter Chunk
items.lore: Electron-degenerate matter from a dead star's core. Absurdly heavy.

items.name: Neutronium Ingot
items.lore: Stabilised neutron-degenerate matter.

items.name: Neutronium Plate
items.lore: Rolled to a thickness of a few femtometres.

items.name: Void Lattice Shard
items.lore: A fragment of the scaffolding between branes.

items.name: Exotic Matter Crystal
items.lore: Negative energy density. It tries to fall upward.

items.name: Qubit
items.lore: |0> and |1> at once, until you look.

items.name: Entangled Photon Pair
items.lore: Measure one and the other already knows.

items.name: Quantum Dot
items.lore: An artificial atom; its colour is set by its size.

items.name: Superposition Crystal
items.lore: Exists in several lattice configurations simultaneously.

items.name: Quantum Processor
items.lore: A fault-tolerant array of logical qubits.

items.name: Casimir Plate
items.lore: Two plates nanometres apart. The vacuum between them pushes.

items.name: Metamaterial Sheet
items.lore: Negative refractive index. Light bends the wrong way.

items.name: Topological Insulator
items.lore: Insulating bulk, conducting surface - protected by topology.

items.name: Superconducting Coil
items.lore: Zero resistance. The current never stops.

items.name: Higgs Field Capacitor
items.lore: Stores a local excitation of the Higgs field. Handles mass.

items.name: Tachyon Crystal
items.lore: Arrives before it was made.

items.name: Chronon Capacitor
items.lore: Holds quanta of time. Handle before use.

items.name: Antimatter Pellet
items.lore: Held in a Penning trap. Do not let it touch anything.

items.name: Strange Matter Pellet
items.lore: Up, down and strange quarks. Possibly contagious.

items.name: Magnetic Monopole
items.lore: A north pole with no south. Dirac would be pleased.

items.name: Cosmic String Segment
items.lore: A one-dimensional defect from the early universe.

items.name: Dark Matter Lens
items.lore: Focuses gravity, not light.

items.name: Calabi-Yau Manifold
items.lore: Six compact dimensions, folded small enough to hold.

items.name: Planck Shard
items.lore: 1.6 x 10^-35 m. You cannot cut it smaller.

items.name: Hawking Emitter
items.lore: Channels the thermal glow of an evaporating horizon.

items.name: Kugelblitz Seed
items.lore: Enough focused light to collapse on itself.

items.name: Alcubierre Coil
items.lore: Contracts space ahead, expands it behind.

items.name: Penrose Spindle
items.lore: Couples to a rotating horizon's ergosphere.

items.name: Micro Singularity
items.lore: A black hole the mass of a mountain, smaller than an atom.

items.name: White Hole Fragment
items.lore: A time-reversed horizon. Nothing can enter.

items.name: Tesseract Core
items.lore: A hypercube's 3D shadow, rotating through a direction you cannot point to.

items.name: Spectral Analyzer
items.lore: Right-click phenomena, blocks or creatures to gain Insight.

items.name: Quantum Codex
items.lore: The Theoretical Sciences field guide.

items.name: Brane Shifter
items.lore: Slip sideways out of this brane and into the Bulk.

items.name: Quantum String
items.lore: A one-dimensional vibrating string. Its mode of vibration decides which particle it is.

items.name: M-Brane
items.lore: A two-dimensional membrane of M-theory. Whole universes can live on one.

items.name: Graviton Crystal
items.lore: Quantised gravity, frozen into a lattice. Feels heavier than it is.

items.name: Spin Foam Lattice
items.lore: Loop quantum gravity: spacetime itself, woven from discrete quanta of area.

items.name: Multiverse Shard
items.lore: Matter from a universe with slightly different constants. Its colour will not settle.

items.name: Rift Anchor
items.lore: Pins a tear between universes open long enough to reach through.

items.name: Universe Seed
items.lore: A grain of false vacuum primed to inflate into a cosmos.

items.name: Pocket Universe
items.lore: An entire cosmos, folded into a bubble you can hold. Please do not drop it.

items.name: Heat Death Remnant
items.lore: All that is left of a universe at maximum entropy. Cold, even and perfectly still.

items.name: Photonic Neuron
items.lore: A neuron that thinks at the speed of light.

items.name: Neural Lattice
items.lore: Billions of photonic neurons in a self-organising mesh.

items.name: Narrow AI Core
items.lore: Superhuman at one thing; useless at everything else.

items.name: General AI Core
items.lore: An artificial general intelligence. It asks good questions.

items.name: Superintelligence Core
items.lore: It has already read this tooltip. And the next one.

items.name: Computronium Ingot
items.lore: Matter arranged for the maximum possible computation per gram.

items.name: Solar Statite
items.lore: A light sail balanced between gravity and radiation pressure.

items.name: Dyson Swarm Satellite
items.lore: One of millions. Feed them to a Dyson Array.

items.name: Dyson Shell Segment
items.lore: A curved plate of a star-enclosing shell. 64 of them close the sphere.

items.name: Stellar Core
items.lore: A captive star the size of a fist, ignited by a white hole.

items.name: Negentropy Cell
items.lore: Order, bottled. Entropy flows backwards inside.

items.name: Maxwell's Demon Chip
items.lore: A tiny intelligence that opens a door for fast molecules only. Thermodynamics objects.

items.name: Holographic Matrix
items.lore: A 3D object stored entirely on its 2D boundary.

items.name: Bekenstein Crystal
items.lore: Holds the maximum information a region of space can contain.

items.name: Source Code Fragment
items.lore: A few lines of the program that runs the universe. Mostly comments.

items.name: Reality Anchor
items.lore: Keeps a patch of reality from being edited.

items.name: Omega Point
items.lore: The final state of all computation. It already knows how this ends.

items.name: Nanite Swarm
items.lore: A billion machines the size of viruses. Hungry.

items.name: Programmable Matter
items.lore: Matter that changes its own shape and properties on command.

items.name: Claytronic Catom
items.lore: One cell of a substance that can become anything.

items.name: Von Neumann Probe
items.lore: Builds copies of itself from whatever it finds. Put one in a Dyson Array.

items.name: Massless Alloy
items.lore: The Higgs field has been told to ignore it.

items.name: Negative Mass Ingot
items.lore: Push it and it comes toward you.

items.name: Inertia Damper
items.lore: Cancels momentum locally. Standard issue on every starship.

items.name: Metallic Hydrogen Ingot
items.lore: Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.

items.name: Sterile Neutrino
items.lore: Interacts with nothing except gravity. Very hard to keep hold of.

items.name: Quark Star Core
items.lore: The heart of a star too dense even for neutrons.

items.name: Magnetar Shard
items.lore: Its magnetic field would wipe a credit card from the Moon.

items.name: Pulsar Timing Crystal
items.lore: Ticks with the precision of a millisecond pulsar.

items.name: Dilithium Crystal
items.lore: Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.

items.name: Annihilation Core
items.lore: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box.

items.name: Wormhole Throat
items.lore: The narrowest point of an Einstein-Rosen bridge, held open with exotic matter.

items.name: Closed Timelike Curve
items.lore: A path through spacetime that ends where - and when - it started.

items.name: Paradox Residue
items.lore: What is left after a contradiction resolves itself.

items.name: Bootstrap Artifact
items.lore: Nobody made it. It was always handed back from the future.

items.name: Cosmological Constant
items.lore: Lambda: the energy of empty space that pushes the universe apart.

items.name: Psionic Crystal
items.lore: Resonates with thought.

items.name: Thought Matrix
items.lore: A thought, frozen in a lattice so it can be copied.

items.name: Boltzmann Brain
items.lore: A mind that fluctuated into existence from random noise. It is very confused.

items.name: Aleph-Null Shard
items.lore: The size of the natural numbers, made solid. Counting its facets never ends.

items.name: Godel Sentence
items.lore: "This statement cannot be proven." It is true, and no system can prove it.

items.name: Banach-Tarski Sphere
items.lore: Cut it into five non-measurable pieces, reassemble them, and you have two spheres.

items.name: Russell Paradox Set
items.lore: The set of all sets that do not contain themselves. Does it contain itself?

items.name: Absolute Infinity
items.lore: Larger than every infinity. It cannot be conceived - and yet here it is.

items.name: Axiom Fragment
items.lore: A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.

items.name: Axiom Key
items.lore: Opens the breach to the space where laws are born. Use it to travel there and back.

items.name: Arbor Heartwood Sample
items.lore: Wood from the World Tree. It is warm, cold, heavy and weightless, sometimes all at once.

items.name: Bubble Universe
items.lore: An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.

items.name: Crystallised Law
items.lore: A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.

items.name: Arbor Simulacrum
items.lore: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe.

items.name: Primordial Ocean Simulacrum
items.lore: A complete simulation of the Ocean of Laws, still bubbling inside its lattice.

items.name: Omnilex
items.lore: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.

items.name: Lattice Seed Crystal
items.lore: A flawless crystal nucleus. Boules grow from it atom by atom.

items.name: Cherenkov Boule
items.lore: A single crystal of Cherenkov quartz, grown in superfluid helium. Ready to be sliced.

items.name: Topological Boule
items.lore: A boule doped with topological insulator. Its surface conducts; its interior never will.

items.name: Hyperdimensional Boule
items.lore: A crystal that extends a little way into the fourth dimension.

items.name: Cherenkov Wafer
items.lore: A wafer sliced from a Cherenkov boule.

items.name: Topological Wafer
items.lore: A wafer whose edges carry current without resistance.

items.name: Hyperdimensional Wafer
items.lore: A wafer with more surface than its area allows.

items.name: Photonic Logic Wafer
items.lore: Engraved with waveguides instead of wires.

items.name: Qubit Array Wafer
items.lore: Thousands of qubits, engraved through a metamaterial lens.

items.name: Topological Logic Wafer
items.lore: Braided anyons on a wafer - errors cannot touch them.

items.name: Hyperdimensional Logic Wafer
items.lore: Circuits laid out in four dimensions, folded flat.

items.name: Cosmic Logic Wafer
items.lore: Etched with a lens made of a cosmic string. Each trace is a light-year long, folded.

items.name: Photonic Die
items.lore: A single photonic logic die.

items.name: Qubit Die
items.lore: A single die of entangled qubits.

items.name: Topological Die
items.lore: A die of topologically protected logic.

items.name: Hyperdimensional Die
items.lore: A die that is larger on the inside.

items.name: Cosmic Die
items.lore: A die holding a galaxy-scale computation.

items.name: Photonic Lens
items.lore: A lithography lens. Not consumed - it focuses light onto wafers forever.

items.name: Tesseract Lens
items.lore: Focuses light through the fourth dimension. A lithography catalyst.

items.name: Cosmic String Lens
items.lore: A loop of cosmic string bends light into perfect focus. A lithography catalyst.

items.name: Femtoscale Capacitor
items.lore: A Casimir capacitor smaller than a proton.

items.name: Femtoscale Transistor
items.lore: A single-qubit switch.

items.name: Femtoscale Inductor
items.lore: A superconducting coil wound around nothing.

items.name: Attoscale Capacitor
items.lore: Stores charge in the Higgs field itself.

items.name: Attoscale Transistor
items.lore: Switches between superposed states before it is asked to.

items.name: Attoscale Inductor
items.lore: Wound from a magnetic monopole's field lines.

items.name: Metamaterial Substrate
items.lore: The blank on which every circuit board is built.

items.name: Photonic Circuit Board
items.lore: A board of light-guides.

items.name: Topological Circuit Board
items.lore: A board whose traces are protected by topology.

items.name: Cosmic Circuit Board
items.lore: A board laid across a Calabi-Yau manifold.

items.name: Photonic Processor
items.lore: Tier I processor. Computes with light.

items.name: Topological Processor
items.lore: Tier III processor. Fault-tolerant by geometry.

items.name: Hyperdimensional Processor
items.lore: Tier IV processor. Its logic gates take inputs from directions that do not exist.

items.name: Cosmic Processor
items.lore: Tier V processor. A computer the size of a galaxy, folded into a chip.

items.name: Ontological Processor
items.lore: Tier VI processor. It does not compute answers - it decides what is true.

items.name: Transfinite Processor
items.lore: Tier VII processor. Finishes infinitely many operations in finite time.

items.name: Higgs Catalyst
items.lore: A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Required (not consumed) by mass-altering processes.

items.name: Spacetime Catalyst
items.lore: A self-sustaining knot of curved spacetime. Required (not consumed) by hyperdimensional processes.

items.name: Eternity Catalyst
items.lore: Time flows through it without passing. Required (not consumed) by the final processes.

items.name: Chronosteel Ingot
items.lore: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. It never ages, rusts or wears.

items.name: Spacetime Alloy Ingot
items.lore: An alloy of matter and curved space. Its reflection shows distant stars.

items.name: Cosmic Neutronium Ingot
items.lore: Neutronium compressed with dark matter in a star's heart. Starlight drifts through it.

items.name: Spacetime Slag
items.lore: Crumpled leftover geometry. A Maxwell's demon can sort useful shards out of it.

items.name: Field Calibrator
items.lore: Use on a multiblock controller to restore its containment, clear a fault and read out the ideal tuning value.

items.name: Autonomous Calibrator
items.lore: Installs into a multiblock controller for good: it follows the drifting tuning and repairs containment by itself, for a 25% power tax.

items.name: Structure Assembler
items.lore: Use on a multiblock controller to build every missing block from your inventory. Sneak-use to preview what is missing.

items.name: Fractured Essence
items.lore: A splinter of reality that broke away from a destabilised creature. It is in several places at once.

items.name: Void Essence
items.lore: What is left of a Void Wraith: a little pocket of nothing that refuses to be filled.

items.name: Dipole Winding
items.lore: Superconducting cable wound into a saddle coil. Its field bends a particle beam into a ring.

items.name: Quadrupole Pole Tip
items.lore: A hyperbolic pole piece ground to within ten nanometres. Four of them squeeze a beam into focus.

items.name: RF Resonator Cell
items.lore: A pill-box cavity of topological superconductor. The standing wave inside kicks each passing bunch forward.

items.name: Tachyon Klystron
items.lore: A microwave amplifier whose electron beam has been replaced with tachyons. It drives RF cavities from slightly in the future.

items.name: Cryocooler Unit
items.lore: A closed-cycle superfluid refrigerator. Superconductors stop superconducting without one.

items.name: Turbomolecular Rotor
items.lore: Bladed discs spinning at ninety thousand rpm, batting gas molecules out of the beamline one at a time.

items.name: Scintillator Crystal
items.lore: Flashes when a particle passes through it. Count the flashes and you know what was made in the collision.

items.name: Pixel Tracker Module
items.lore: A qubit-array sensor that records the exact path of every charged particle crossing it.

items.name: Plasma Nozzle Tip
items.lore: A converging magnetic nozzle that accelerates plasma to a few percent of light speed.

items.name: Gravitic Lens Element
items.lore: A dark-matter lens trimmed so its Einstein ring falls exactly where you need it.

items.name: Hawking Absorber Plate
items.lore: Metamaterial tuned to soak up the thermal glow a black hole gives off as it evaporates.

items.name: Error-Correction Lattice
items.lore: Thousands of physical qubits standing guard over one logical qubit, voting out every error.

items.name: Spacetime Anchor Core
items.lore: Negative mass pinned inside spacetime alloy. It holds the metric still while everything around it bends.

items.name: Dimensional Stabiliser Matrix
items.lore: Compactified dimensions woven tight with quantum strings, so they stay rolled up under load.

items.name: Causal Shield Lattice
items.lore: Chronosteel threaded with stored chronons. Paradoxes that hit it are deflected into somebody else's timeline.

items.name: Degenerate Armour Plate
items.lore: Neutronium held at stellar-core pressure by a spacetime-alloy frame. Starlight does not dent it.

items.name: Pentaquark Shard
items.lore: Five quarks bound into one exotic hadron. They only exist for an instant - unless you crystallise them.

items.name: Glueball Core
items.lore: A particle made of nothing but the force carriers that hold quarks together.

items.name: Hyperon Crystal
items.lore: Strange baryons locked into a lattice. The strangeness makes them heavier than they have any right to be.

items.name: Hypernova Alloy Ingot
items.lore: Forged in a plasma hotter than a collapsing star. Still glowing, and always will be.

items.name: Transcendent Metal Ingot
items.lore: A metal whose properties are set by the forge, not by physics.

items.name: Horizon Shard
items.lore: A sliver of event horizon brought back out of a simulated universe. Everything that falls into it is remembered.

items.name: Natural Number Lattice
items.lore: One, two, three... Peano built all of arithmetic from zero and "the next one".

items.name: Integer Ring
items.lore: The naturals, plus their antimatter reflections: every number now has a negative.

items.name: Rational Field
items.lore: Every ratio of integers. Dense everywhere - and still full of holes.

items.name: Real Continuum
items.lore: The rationals with every gap filled - including the transcendental numbers mined from the Platonic Realm.

items.name: Imaginary Unit
items.lore: The square root of minus one, distilled from the imaginary mass of a tachyon.

items.name: Complex Plane
items.lore: Real and imaginary at right angles. Every polynomial finally has its roots.

items.name: Quaternion Crystal
items.lore: Hamilton carved i² = j² = k² = ijk = -1 into a bridge. Here it is carved into a crystal: pure rotation.

items.name: Octonion Crystal
items.lore: Eight dimensions, and multiplication no longer associates. The largest number system that still divides.

items.name: Surreal Number
items.lore: Conway's numbers: every real, every ordinal, every infinitesimal - all in one ordered field.

items.name: Prime Shard
items.lore: Divisible only by itself and one. Grows naturally in the Platonic Realm; otherwise it has to be sieved out.

items.name: Modular Form
items.lore: A function so symmetric it is called "the fifth fundamental operation of arithmetic".

items.name: Riemann Zeta Crystal
items.lore: Every non-trivial zero lies on the critical line. Probably. This crystal grew along it.

items.name: Transcendental Crystal
items.lore: π and e, which no polynomial can reach. Only found in the Platonic Realm.

items.name: Infinitesimal
items.lore: Smaller than every positive number, yet not zero.

items.name: Function Graph
items.lore: A rule that sends every input to exactly one output - drawn as a curve of light.

items.name: Derivative Operator
items.lore: Instantaneous rate of change: the slope of a curve at a single point.

items.name: Integral Operator
items.lore: The area under a curve, summed from infinitely many infinitesimal slices.

items.name: Fourier Series
items.lore: Any signal is a sum of waves. This one is a sum of all of them.

items.name: Fractal Set
items.lore: z → z² + c, iterated forever. Infinitely detailed at every scale.

items.name: Fractal Dust
items.lore: Self-similar grit from the Platonic Realm. Every grain contains smaller copies of the whole pile.

items.name: Differential Manifold
items.lore: A space that is flat up close and curved far away - the stage on which relativity is written.

items.name: Möbius Strip
items.lore: One side, one edge. Walk along it and you come back upside down.

items.name: Klein Bottle
items.lore: A bottle with no inside. It only fits together in four dimensions.

items.name: Axiom Schema
items.lore: The rules you agree to before you prove anything.

items.name: Empty Set
items.lore: The set with nothing in it - made from the nothing a Void Wraith leaves behind.

items.name: Power Set
items.lore: The set of all subsets. Always strictly bigger than what you started with.

items.name: Formal Proof Tree
items.lore: Every step justified, every axiom cited. Machines can check it; humans rarely can.

items.name: Continuum Shard
items.lore: The cardinality of the real line. Is it the next infinity after aleph-null? The axioms cannot say.

items.name: Axiom of Choice
items.lore: From every set of sets you may pick one of each. Accept it and spheres can be doubled.

items.name: Category Lattice
items.lore: Objects and arrows, and nothing else. All of mathematics fits inside.

items.name: Functor Bridge
items.lore: A map between categories that keeps every arrow pointing the right way.

items.name: Topos
items.lore: A universe of mathematics with its own internal logic. Change the topos and you change what is true.

items.name: Up & Down Quarks
items.lore: The two lightest quark flavours - everything you have ever touched is made of them.

items.name: Strange & Charm Quarks
items.lore: The second generation: heavier, and they only exist for an instant outside strange matter.

items.name: Bottom & Top Quarks
items.lore: The third generation. The top quark weighs as much as a gold atom and decays before it can bind to anything.

items.name: Lepton Triplet
items.lore: Electron, muon and tau - with a neutrino shadowing each.

items.name: Gauge Boson Cluster
items.lore: Photon, gluon, W and Z: the carriers of every force except gravity.

items.name: Higgs Boson Crystal
items.lore: An excitation of the field that gives everything its mass, frozen before it could decay.

items.name: Standard Model Matrix
items.lore: Every known particle in one lattice. It explains almost everything - except gravity and dark matter.

items.name: Superpartner Shard
items.lore: A neutralino: the supersymmetric twin of a boson. It turns out to be what dark matter is made of.

items.name: Grand Unified Core
items.lore: At high enough energy the strong, weak and electromagnetic forces are one force again.

items.name: Lorentz Transform Crystal
items.lore: Lengths shrink and clocks slow as you approach light speed. This crystal is always moving at 0.99c.

items.name: Minkowski Lattice
items.lore: Space and time as one four-dimensional geometry, with light cones at every point.

items.name: Metric Tensor
items.lore: g_μν: the rule for measuring distance in curved spacetime.

items.name: Riemann Curvature Tensor
items.lore: How much a vector turns when carried around a small loop - curvature itself.

items.name: Einstein Field Core
items.lore: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.

items.name: Gravitational Wave Crystal
items.lore: A ripple in spacetime from two merging black holes, caught and frozen mid-oscillation.

items.name: Kerr Metric Shard
items.lore: The exact geometry around a spinning black hole - ergosphere and all.

items.name: Protostar Core
items.lore: A collapsing knot of nebular gas, hot enough to glow but not yet to fuse.

items.name: Red Giant Envelope
items.lore: The swollen outer layers of a dying star, a hundred times wider than it once was.

items.name: White Dwarf Core
items.lore: A star's carbon heart, the size of a planet and held up only by electron degeneracy.

items.name: Stellar Iron Ingot
items.lore: Iron from the core of a star - the end of fusion. Making anything heavier costs energy instead of releasing it.

items.name: Supernova Remnant
items.lore: What is left after a star's core collapses and its outer layers are blasted across the galaxy.

items.name: R-Process Cluster
items.lore: Gold, platinum and uranium, forged in seconds by the neutron flood of a supernova.

items.name: Kaluza-Klein Shard
items.lore: Momentum around a fifth dimension curled up too small to see. Mined in the Bulk.

items.name: Dilaton Crystal
items.lore: A frozen value of the string coupling - how strongly strings interact. Grows on the Graviton Reefs of the Bulk.

items.name: Moduli Crystal
items.lore: The shape and size of the hidden dimensions, crystallised. Found in the Moduli Wastes of the Bulk.

items.name: Brane Tension Fiber
items.lore: A thread pulled from the membrane a Brane Strider walks on.

items.name: Graviton Wisp Core
items.lore: The heart of a Graviton Wisp: a closed loop of gravity that still pulls on your hand.

items.name: Compactified Circle
items.lore: A whole dimension rolled up into a circle smaller than a Planck length.

items.name: String Coupling Crystal
items.lore: Tunes how strongly strings split and join. Turn it up and string theory becomes a different string theory.

items.name: D-Brane Sheet
items.lore: The surface where open strings end. Our universe might be one.

items.name: G₂ Manifold
items.lore: Seven curled-up dimensions whose symmetry is the automorphism group of the octonions.

items.name: M-Theory Core
items.lore: Eleven dimensions, and all five string theories turn out to be one.

items.name: Arrow of Time Shard
items.lore: Entropy only goes up - that is all "forward" means. This shard points the other way.

items.name: Temporal Knot
items.lore: A worldline tied into a knot. Untie it and something happens twice.

items.name: Novikov Crystal
items.lore: The self-consistency principle, crystallised: any time loop it is part of has no paradoxes.

items.name: Wave Packet
items.lore: A particle, written as a sum of waves - localised, but never exactly.

items.name: Spinor Lattice
items.lore: Turn it through 360 degrees and it comes back negative. It takes 720 to restore it.

items.name: Quantum Field Lattice
items.lore: Particles are only ripples. The field is what is real.

items.name: Feynman Diagram
items.lore: Every possible history, summed. Each line is a particle, each vertex an interaction.

items.name: Mathematics Singularity
items.lore: Every number, function, proof and infinity, compressed into one point.

items.name: Standard Model Singularity
items.lore: Every particle that exists, compressed into one point.

items.name: Spacetime Singularity
items.lore: All of relativity, compressed into the one place relativity breaks down.

items.name: Stellar Singularity
items.lore: The whole life of a star, compressed into one point.

items.name: Dimensional Singularity
items.lore: All eleven dimensions, compressed into none.

items.name: Temporal Singularity
items.lore: Every moment there has ever been, compressed into one instant.

items.name: Quantum Singularity
items.lore: Every possible state at once, compressed into one point.

items.name: Cognitive Singularity
items.lore: Every thought that could be thought, compressed into one point.

items.name: Exotic Matter Singularity
items.lore: Negative mass, antimatter, strange matter and dark matter, compressed into one point.

items.name: Theory of Everything
items.lore: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.

items.name: Omniscience Catalyst
items.lore: All nine singularities, fused. Holding it, you know everything - briefly.

items.name: Omnium Ingot
items.lore: A metal made of every concept there is. The last ingot.

items.name: Platonic Compass
items.lore: Points at the realm of ideal forms - and, used, takes you there (and back).

items.lore: 2,048 computronium ingot, crushed into one point.

items.name: Cosmic Neutronium Singularity
items.lore: 1,024 cosmic neutronium ingot, crushed into one point.

items.name: Cherenkov Lattice
items.lore: Diamond and Cherenkov quartz woven around netherite: a frame for a crystal that should not exist.

items.name: Crystalline Matrix Ingot
items.lore: Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.

items.name: Biosphere Compendium
items.lore: One of every creature that can be eaten, pressed into one. Do not eat.

items.name: Primordial Harvest
items.lore: Every crop that has ever grown, in one seed.

items.name: Hyperdimensional Pearl
items.lore: A pearl that teleports to everywhere at once.

items.name: Cosmic Record Fragment
items.lore: A sliver of a disc that recorded the Big Bang.

items.name: Virtual Quark
items.lore: A quark borrowed from the vacuum. It wants to go back.

items.name: Virtual Graviton
items.lore: A quantum of gravity that has not yet decided to exist.

items.name: Virtual Photon
items.lore: Light that never left anything and will never arrive.

items.name: Virtual Monopole
items.lore: A magnet with one pole. The vacuum only lends these briefly.

items.name: Planck Diver
items.lore: Shrinks you past the Planck length into the Quantum Foam. Use again to come back.

items.name: Resonance Probe
items.lore: Reads the four virtual-particle resonances where you stand in the Quantum Foam.

items.name: Omnium Singularity
items.lore: Two hundred and fifty-six Omnium Ingots in one point. There is nothing left to compress it into.

items.name: Fractal Core
items.lore: The smallest copy of a Fractal Wyrm. It is also the largest.

items.name: Proof Fragment
items.lore: Part of a proof an Axiom Sentinel was writing about you. QED.

items.name: Wavefunction
items.lore: Everything a particle could be, written down at once.

items.name: Hamiltonian Operator
items.lore: Ask it how a system changes and it answers with the energy.

items.name: Eigenstate Lattice
items.lore: The states a measurement is allowed to find, and no others.

items.name: Path Integral
items.lore: Every way of getting from here to there, added up.

items.name: Geodesic Thread
items.lore: The straightest possible line - through curved spacetime.

items.name: Christoffel Symbol
items.lore: How the coordinates twist from one point to the next.

items.name: Stress-Energy Tensor
items.lore: Matter tells spacetime how to curve. This is what it says.

items.name: Einstein-Rosen Core
items.lore: Both ends of a bridge between a black hole and a white hole, held in one hand.

items.name: Tidal Alloy Scrap
items.lore: Metal pulled thin by tides stronger than its bonds.

items.name: Frozen Photon
items.lore: Light that reached the horizon and stopped there, red-shifted to nothing.

items.name: Retrocausal Crystal
items.lore: It formed after you mined it.

items.name: Primordial Ejecta
items.lore: Matter a white hole threw out before there was anything to throw.

items.name: Geodesic Anchor
items.lore: Keeps your worldline your own. Without one, the inside of a black or white hole kills you in two seconds.

items.name: Horizon Diver
items.lore: Crosses an event horizon - inward. Use again to come back out, which should be impossible.

items.name: Ordinal Shard
items.lore: A piece of the order in which infinities come.

items.name: Cardinal Shard
items.lore: A piece of how many there are - even when there are infinitely many.

items.name: Hypersphere Fragment
items.lore: A curved piece of a sphere with a 3-dimensional surface.

items.name: Omega
items.lore: The first number after all of the counting numbers.

items.name: Epsilon-Naught
items.lore: Omega to the omega to the omega... forever. And still countable.

items.name: Omega-One
items.lore: The first ordinal that cannot be counted.

items.name: Aleph-One
items.lore: The next size of infinity after the countable one.

items.name: Inaccessible Cardinal
items.lore: An infinity so large nothing smaller can build it.

items.name: Hopf Fibration
items.lore: A 3-sphere unwound into circles, every two of them linked.

items.name: Penteract Lattice
items.lore: A five-dimensional cube: 32 corners, 80 edges, 40 cells.

items.name: E8 Lattice
items.lore: The densest way to pack spheres in eight dimensions.

items.name: Cantor Key
items.lore: Opens the Transfinite Hierarchy, where every infinity has its own place. Use again to return.

items.name: False Vacuum Membrane
items.lore: The skin of a Vacuum Drifter: the wall between two vacua.

items.name: Hilbert's Hotel Key
items.lore: Opens room n+1. There is always a room n+1.

items.name: Brane Tether
items.lore: Ties your mass to our brane. Carry it in the Bulk - or in any field of extra dimensions.

items.name: Primordial Charter
items.lore: A copy of the laws as they were first written. Carry it in Hyperdimensional Reality.

items.name: Form of the Self
items.lore: Your own ideal form, cut in crystal. Carry it in the Platonic Realm.

items.name: Coherence Stabiliser
items.lore: Keeps your wavefunction in one piece. Carry it in the Quantum Foam - or in an altered vacuum.

items.name: Well-Ordering Charm
items.lore: Every descent ends somewhere. Carry it in the Transfinite Hierarchy.

items.name: Identity Kernel
items.lore: The smallest thing that is still you. Carry it in the Transcendental.

items.name: Graviton Harness
items.lore: Spreads crushing gravity evenly through you. Carry it into high-gravity fields.

items.name: Chronal Anchor
items.lore: Holds your own clock steady. Carry it into fields where time runs fast or slow.

items.name: Proof of Everything
items.lore: What Alpha Omega left behind: a proof that you understood. The Transcendental opens only to it.

items.name: Entanglement Tuner
items.lore: Links Entangled Transceivers to one channel. Sneak-use a transceiver to switch it between sending and receiving.

items.name: Empirical Dossier
items.lore: Every early discovery, written up. A Research Nexus can study it in your place.

items.name: Theoretical Dossier
items.lore: The theories of the middle ages of your research. Feeds a Research Nexus.

items.name: Unified Dossier
items.lore: Everything up to the edge of mathematics, unified. Feeds a Research Nexus.

items.name: Absolute Dossier
items.lore: The research of a civilisation that has nearly finished. Feeds a Research Nexus.

items.lore: One third of a Research Dossier.

items.lore: One third of a Research Dossier.
